[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Buffer Analyze: Offers insights into social media performance across Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Union Metrics: Provides insights into follower growth, engagement rates, and content performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Cyfe: Offers a social media analytics dashboard integrating multiple platforms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Google Data Studio: A free tool for creating custom dashboards and reports using data from various sources.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Consider platform integrations, features, cost, ease of use, and customization when choosing a tool.  
[USER] Asked if any of the recommended tools can schedule social media posts in advance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Many of the tools offer social media scheduling capabilities.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Sprout Social: Yes, enables planning and scheduling posts across various platforms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Agorapulse: Yes, allows scheduling across Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Union Metrics: No scheduling capabilities, primarily an analytics tool.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Cyfe: No scheduling capabilities, business analytics platform.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Google Data Studio: No scheduling capabilities, data visualization tool.
